result.instructions: Tools for Decimal POS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the price and stock of the product with code 012345678905?"; "Show me the order with external id 10432 and its invoice."; "List the vendor bills from invoice dates in October 2026.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Decimal POS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run decimalpos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run decimalpos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run decimalpos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. decimalpos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (item catalog: code, description, price, stock) sorted by product id. Costs 1 credit per request. Use lastMod for incremental sync. Requires the product:get scope.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page. Send all other parameters again.

lastMod.description: ISO 8601: only products changed since this time.

lastSold.description: ISO 8601: only products sold since this time.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_product
tools.title: Get product by id
tools.description: Get one product by its numeric id. Costs 1 credit. Unit price = price ÷ priceQty. Requires product:get.

tools.name: decimalpos_get_product_by_code
tools.title: Get product by code
tools.description: Get one product by its SKU or item code (UPC). Costs 1 credit. Requires product:get.

code.description: Product SKU or item code, e.g. 012345678905.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List all customers, sorted by last change. Needs customer:get with all access (a sensitive scope; an own-access key gets 403). Costs 1 credit per request. Personal data: request only what the task needs.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page. Send all other parameters again.

lastMod.description: ISO 8601: only customers changed since this time.

tools.name: decimalpos_list_sale_records
tools.title: List sale records for one item

itemCode.description: Item code from the permission list, or an alias of it.

startDate.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD. Not in the future.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 31 days after startDate. Not in the future.
